svg.title: Data and personalisation: events to search, recommendations and forecasts
svg.text: Data and personalisation: how a click turns into better search, recommendations and stock forecasts
Nothing here sits on the checkout path. If this whole page is down, the store still sells; it just stops getting smarter for a while.
Rules that keep this useful (and legal)
One event schema, versioned, owned by a team. Every event has event_id, session_id, user_id (if consented), sku, ts.
Consent first: no user_id on events from shoppers who said no. Drop or hash PII in Dataflow before BigQuery.
Send the same user events to AI Commerce Search that you use for analytics, or the models learn from a different store.
Catalog in AI Commerce Search is updated from Spanner change streams, so a price or stock change shows up in minutes.
Measure recs with an A/B test on revenue per session, not click-through rate.
